correction_reason: Independent visual-review-v002 rejected all original mouths, fork nub; all inspected actual outputs and diagnostic mouth crops, not prompt claims.
continuity_choice: Accepted S032 gold-art-v006 was examined as generated prop/finish example only. Its lower-tooth location was initially targeted, but story never specifies tooth location. Current closed smiles expose one small side tooth in opening/crowd; position remains provisional interpretation not canon. Fork text is waiting before route choice, does not require exposed tooth; closed mouth deliberately conceals all teeth. Coordinator confirmed text-grounded concealed tooth is appropriate.

opening-art-v006: One clear small gold triangle visible on narrow smile, no prior broad block. Full four-leg ownership/support, fine Neet legs and short-body silhouettes retained.
crowd-art-v010: One distinct pointed side gold tooth; moustache overlaps far mouth. Tiny warm speck under opposite moustache remains for reviewer to distinguish from a second tooth; no second pointed tooth shown. Five separate dogs and grounded paws retained; body finish broad flat planes.
fork-art-v010: Entire replacement opened: closed muzzle conceals all teeth/gold, nearflush nub retained; connected bodies and supported legs, wider fork composition and regional facial furnishings retained. Smooth finish corrected after reintroduced surface marks.
